snippet.title: Adventure of Samsara - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Adventure of Samsara is coming on September 4th! This brand new metroidvania developed by Ilex Games will challenge players as they go on an adventure to defend the Orphics. Explore and grow stronger to face off against tough enemies and unique bosses. Pre-order Adventure of Samsara today!

Pre-Order: https://atari.com/products/adventure-of-samsara

Join the Atari Discord: https://link.atari.com/atariclubdiscord

Follow Atari
Twitter: https://twitter.com/atari
